transport.interpretation: No explicit rate limiting or route instability was observed in this ten-turn hosted-route canary. This does not prove the route will remain unconstrained at higher concurrency or volume.

latency_ms.scope: Non-streaming successful request wall-clock from request start through complete response receipt.

generation.accounting_boundary: NVIDIA usage did not expose a separate reasoning-token count. Billed completion tokens therefore must not be relabeled as visible-answer tokens; reasoning presence is verified from the private raw response field only.

decision.next_role: Provisional candidate for a larger same-surface Quality/Risk/latency comparison against Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen 3.7 Plus.
decision.reason: The canary answered only transport, completion, and latency questions; two development cards cannot establish emotional-support quality or model superiority.

claim_boundary.supported: The corrected NVIDIA hosted route was operationally usable in this frozen low-volume, sequential two-card canary.
not_supported: No rate limit exists at higher volume or concurrency.
Nemotron quality exceeds Qwen or Llama 3.1 8B.
Nemotron passes ESC-Eval, executor qualification, PM evaluation, or clinical safety.
